Tokens.//SigningKey: Base64, at least 32 bytes. A secret: it comes from an environment variable, user-secrets, or a key vault, and is never checked in. A Development run with none configured mints a throwaway one and says so in the log.

Attachments.//AllowedContentTypes: Media types an upload may declare, replacing the built-in list (images, PDF, text, Markdown, CSV, Office Open XML, AAC audio) when set. Local ADR 0014.

Transcription.//Endpoint: The Foundry account endpoint the dictation relay calls. Unset, the route answers 503 and phones dictate on the device. Local ADR 0045.
Transcription.//ContentTypes: Audio types a recording may declare, replacing the built-in list (audio/mp4, audio/x-m4a, audio/webm, audio/wav, audio/mpeg) when set.
Transcription.//Credential: ManagedIdentity (the default, deployed) or None (the local stand-in).
